authorityOrder: host project's exact installed Three.js version and lockfile
matching official mrdoob/three.js source, manual, API docs and examples
officialThreejs.note: r185 is the audited baseline, not an instruction to overwrite another project version.

localOfficialSourceSkills.selectionMode: director plus at most one to three topic skills required for the current stage
localOfficialSourceSkills.sourceBoundary: Original workflow guidance derived from official Three.js sources; not an official mrdoob/three.js product.

verifiedExclusions.reason: Not present in official r185 source.
verifiedExclusions.replacement: Use an official vanilla Three.js shadow receiver or separately reviewed third-party component.

verifiedExclusions.reason: Not present in official r185 package.
verifiedExclusions.replacement: Verify every WebGPU/TSL import against official source for the host version.

rejectedRuntimeAuthority.reason: Popular third-party skill pack, but no root LICENSE or GitHub SPDX identification and known invalid examples. It is not bundled, installed by this kit, or used as runtime authority.

threeui.role: Optional verified Community React component source, never scene-direction authority.
threeui.publicInstall: Pin and review the @designcodeio/threeui package or a component subpath; copy only required assets.
threeui.proInstall: The Pro CLI requires account entitlement and explicit user approval.
threeui.fallback: Build directly with the host project's Three.js version when no component fits the locked scene.
